summary: Telegram could not retrieve content from the HTTP URL.

match_any.description_exact: Bad Request: failed to get HTTP URL content

possible_causes: Retrieving content from the URL failed.
diagnostic_limits: The response does not distinguish DNS, network, TLS, HTTP, or origin-access failures.

evidence.note: WEBPAGE_CURL_FAILED is rewritten to this description.
The rewrite runs only after the error is normalized to code 400.
Adds the code-specific prefix and lowercases only the initial character of ordinary messages.

response.description: Bad Request: failed to get HTTP URL content

preconditions: Check that Telegram can retrieve the resource without browser sessions or private-network access; retry only under a bounded policy.
